notes: 전체 기본판 자산: 16개 장소 타일을 공식 Short Paths 기본 배치로 표시하고 Short/Long/번호순/조건부 무작위 전체배치 데이터를 tableModel에 함께 보존합니다. 이동 인접성은 현재 4×4 좌표로부터 상하좌우만 계산합니다.
주요 저장 상태는 공용 장소 점유·장소별 부착물, 상인 아래/장소에 남은 조수 스택, 가족 구성원, 중립 Governor/Smuggler, 4개 상품 지시자와 확장 0–3, Ruby 트랙, 모스크 타일·요구 타일·우편 표식·보너스 카드 더미/버림/손패, Lira·주사위·차례/중단 지점입니다.
Istanbul Big Box 룰북의 기본판만 전사했습니다. 커피·길드·장벽·편지·동료·추가 장소 및 5×5 확장 바자르는 포함하지 않습니다. SVG/JSON은 별도 자산이며 앱 저장/렌더 연결과 규칙 엔진은 구현하지 않습니다.

Wheelbarrow source drawing and three physical extensions define 0–2 base capacity and 0–5 maximum per good; Ruby track shows five goal spaces, plus the 2-player sixth space. These values describe the printed base-game mat, not a runtime implementation.

structureEvidence.location: Official Pegasus product page; identifies Big Box as base game plus two expansions
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Edition boundary; base game is distinct from both expansions; product supports 2-5 players.

structureEvidence.location: Official English Big Box rulebook, base-game pages 4-9 and 18-19, 22, 24; official diagrams pages 6-7 directly rendered and viewed
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 16 base Places in a 4x4 grid; short/long/numbered/random setups; 2-5 players; tile/place identities and actions; starting merchant/assistant/family setup; mail and demand tracking; two Mosque boards, Ruby sources, goods wheelbarrow, bonus draw/discard and neutral tokens; expansion sections explicitly excluded.
structureEvidence.access: local official PDF and extracted text; diagrams visually reviewed

assetScope.editionName: Istanbul base game (2014), using base-game portions of Pegasus Istanbul Big Box rulebook

edition.name: Istanbul base game (2014 rules; Pegasus Big Box base sections only)

tableModel.purpose: Complete neutral visual and state-coordinate specification for recreating/resuming the base-game table. It is an asset model only; it does not add application/API integration, rule automation, legal-move checking, or commercial component artwork.

coordinates.tileSlotIdentity: placeId follows the physical Place tile number, independent of row/column.

merchantStack: four assistant discs stacked beneath the merchant at Fountain 7
perPlayer.startingLira: starting player 2; each next player clockwise has one more than player to their right

shared.mosqueTileStacks: four stacks sorted by tile ability/color and printed goods-symbol requirement; top tile shows two symbols
shared.mosqueRubySupply: one per player on each mosque, with the two-player setup cap from the printed rules
shared.demandStacks: dark stack at Large Market 10 and light stack at Small Market 11, top tile face up
shared.postOffice: four Mail indicators in top row
shared.governorAndSmuggler: each initial place determined by two dice and place number
shared.bonusCards: face-down draw pile; discard pile face up at Caravansary 6

grid.neighborsDerivedFrom: current row/column placement, not from immutable tile numbers
grid.regularMovement: one or two orthogonally adjacent place steps; exceptional card effects are represented by a turn note/state, not validated here

constraints: Fountain 7 must occupy one of the inner four positions.
Black Market 8 and Tea House 9 must not share a row or column.
Black Market 8 and Tea House 9 must be at least three Place positions apart.

layout.coordinatesForCurrentBoard: each grid cell in areas[].slots has its current placeId; permutation may be replaced by any documented preset or random legal permutation.

places.name: Wainwright
places.baseAction: Pay 7 Lira; take one available extension and install it. On the third installation only, take the Wainwright Ruby.

places.name: Fabric Warehouse
places.baseAction: Fill the blue goods track to its current capacity.

places.name: Spice Warehouse
places.baseAction: Fill the red goods track to its current capacity.

places.name: Fruit Warehouse
places.baseAction: Fill the yellow goods track to its current capacity.

places.name: Post Office
places.baseAction: Collect the resources shown on four uncovered mail spaces; move the leftmost top-row mail marker down. If all are already below, return all four to the top row.

places.name: Caravansary
places.baseAction: Draw two Bonus cards and discard one to the face-up pile at place 6; this action may draw from the face-up discard pile.

places.name: Fountain
places.baseAction: Return any number of own assistants to the active merchant stack; no assistant or payment is needed at this place.

places.name: Black Market
places.baseAction: Gain one red, yellow, or green good; roll two dice and gain blue goods for the roll band.

places.name: Tea House
places.baseAction: Record a declared number 3–12, two dice, and the awarded Lira.

places.name: Large Market
places.baseAction: Sell 1–5 goods matching the current dark demand tile, then rotate that tile to the bottom of the dark stack.

places.name: Small Market
places.baseAction: Sell 1–5 goods matching the current light demand tile, then rotate that tile to the bottom of the light stack.

places.name: Police Station
places.baseAction: Move own family member from Police Station to a selected place; that place action is resolved without encounters.

places.name: Sultan’s Palace
places.baseAction: Deliver all required goods not covered by the next Ruby; take the next Ruby from this ascending track.

places.name: Small Mosque
places.baseAction: Take one qualifying tile from the Small Mosque; record tile identity/ability and one-use Ruby reward when both Small Mosque tiles are owned.

places.name: Great Mosque
places.baseAction: Take one qualifying tile from the Great Mosque; record tile identity/ability and one-use Ruby reward when both Great Mosque tiles are owned.

places.name: Gemstone Dealer
places.baseAction: Pay the largest number not covered by a Ruby on the track; take the next Ruby.

topology.occupancyByPlace: zero or more player merchant stacks, assistants, family members, Governor/Smuggler, and place-specific attached tokens/cards/rubies. Distinguish a merchant stack from assistants left behind at that Place.

occupantPlacement.tileBinding: Resolve placeId to the current city slot, so token positions follow the movable Place tile across every layout.
occupantPlacement.order: Group tokens by ownerId and role, then preserve stackOrder within each merchant/assistant stack. Family, Governor, Smuggler, and place attachments keep distinct token IDs.
occupantPlacement.overflow: If token art cannot fit, compact visually or show a count badge; never discard identities or infer a token location from a neighboring Place.

topology.movementPath: derive orthogonal neighbors from the current 4x4 placement. A placed Barrier is not part of the base game and must be tagged as expansion state, not implied by this asset.

stateGroups.derived: orthogonal adjacency from coordinates; do not persist a second potentially inconsistent graph.

stateGroups.unknownPolicy: Use null/unknown rather than inferring a resolved phase from piece locations.

stateGroups.wheelbarrow: four goods tracks begin at capacity 2, each of three extensions increases capacity by one, maximum 5; marker value 0 means empty. Ruby storage has five goal spaces for 3-5 players and a sixth for 2 players.

stateGroups.hiddenOrderPolicy: If physical hidden order cannot be reconstructed, preserve count and unknown card IDs/order as null; never invent card identity.

stateGroups.visibility: owner-only; never duplicate into shared place occupancy.

placeCatalog.componentOverlayNotes: Place tiles stay separate from occupants. A card, goods token, Ruby, die result, or worker at a tile is an overlay with its own owner/face/order; do not replace the Place tile identity with the overlay.

playerMatTemplate.instances: one identical state panel per participating player (2-5); the SVG shows one reusable template, not an assumption that only one player exists.

componentInventory.state: identity plus grid row/column and rotation
one player template per seated player
three extension levels for each of five colors; identify installed owner and remaining supply
draw pile, face-up discard stack, owner-private hands
four color/ability stacks, tile identity, printed requirement, owner and mosque of acquisition
dark/large-market and light/small-market stacks; preserve current face-up and order when known
player holdings and shared bank by denomination or exact total
top/bottom row and order at Post Office
shared supply, Sultan/Gemstone/Wainwright/Mosque sources and player wheelbarrows
last face and pending roll resolution
owner, place, stack order, indicator value

assetLimitations: Base game only: excludes Mocha & Baksheesh places 17-20, Coffee, Tavern/Guild/Barrier components, and Letters & Seals places 21-25/Kiosk/Letters/Companion/Courier.
The official rules do not define an application editor or data encoding; this is a standalone visual/state contract for later integration.
No movement legality, turn resolution, dice odds, payment checking, or win adjudication is implemented.
Hidden deck order and any visually unreadable card identity remain unknown rather than synthesized.

includes: all 16 place tiles and all official base layout presets
orthogonal place topology and per-place component overlays
player merchant/assistant/family positions and stack order
4 goods tracks, 3 wheelbarrow upgrades, 5/6 Ruby tracks
both mosque stacks/owned abilities and Ruby supplies
Post Office mail markers, two market demand stacks
Bonus draw/discard/owner hand, dice, neutral movers, coin and general token state
turn/checkpoint fields required to resume a paused record
notClaimed: reconstructed identities of hidden/unknown card order
